correctness.rationale: Explicit rational coordinates with factored sqrt(3) give 27 distinct unit vectors, 16 mutual inner products 1/4 and 10 equal -1/2 at each point. I independently recomputed all 729 inner products and adjacency-identity entries A²=8I+2A+8J, hence eigenvalues 16^1,4^6,(-2)^20. The addition theorem gives the exact B_k=I+a_k A+b_k(J-I-A), with sector eigenvalues 1+16a+10b, 1+4a-5b,1-2a+b. Independent exact rational Gegenbauer recurrence through k21 matches the displayed 0..8 table, including rank 26 only at k4,7; independent rank-sector checks k8..21 full. The analytic identity C_k^(2)=U_(k+1)'/2 and |P_k(t)|<=3/[(k+1)(k+2)(1-t²)^(3/2)] gives 16|a|+10|b|<304/[3(k+1)(k+2)]<1 for every integer k>=9; this proves the infinite tail. λ0,k is a sum of squared harmonic coordinate sums divided by 27h_k, so it vanishes precisely in positive degrees 1,2,3,4,7. Finite rational checks corroborate, do not establish k>=9.

originality.rationale: The 27-point Schläfli two-distance configuration, its 4-design strength, adjacency spectrum and normalized addition formula are classical. Boyvalenkov 1995 establishes distance distribution/uniqueness of the tight 27-point 4-design, while Bannai–Okuda–Tagami and Zhu et al. develop harmonic-index designs. Those statements entail classical 1..4 cancellations and spectral reduction but the material inspected does not provide all exact-degree ranks, isolated degree-seven rank-26 defect and a proof of all k>=8 full rank. Exceptional invariant-theory literature remains a specific uninspected risk.
residual_risks: The 1995 primary paper was not accessible in full; institutional access request was blocked by tool safety controls and was not bypassed or retried.
Older exceptional association-scheme, Weyl E6 invariant or cubature literature may already calculate all-degree ranks or seventh-index cancellation.
Arithmetic verification through k21 is finite; k>=9 follows only by the analytic Gegenbauer envelope.

value.rationale: For a unique exceptional tight spherical four-design, whether a single harmonic degree interpolates all 27 labels is a natural exact invariant. The nonmonotonic rank loss at k=7 after full rank at k=5 and k=6, eventual full surjectivity, and complete harmonic-index vanishing set give useful structural information beyond its established spherical 4-design property.
